name: algorithms
summary: ^IVG.NKGBuild (exclusive, 900 s) is the one rebuild lock: BuildNKG (TraversalBuild.cls:288-311) and the reader-triggered EnsureNKG (:399-424, unlocked pre-check, re-check under the lock). Interning takes ^NKG("$NI"/"$LI", name) exclusively only when its lock-free fast path finds no entry (GraphIndex.cls:43-100). BuildKG takes the parent ^IVG.AdjW shared (module 04). Every algorithm read is lock-free (ALG-P6, Centrality.cls:25-28) and the result cache relies on the version-token protocol, not a lock. PENDING-LIVE
